words.defn_en: to understand, know, become aware of:

sentences.en: It took her a while to ______ the subtle change in her friend's mood.
sentences.zh: 她過了一會兒才察覺到朋友情緒上細微的變化。

sentences.en: Many people ______ the new policy as unfair to small businesses.
sentences.zh: 許多人認為這項新政策對小型企業不公平。

sentences.en: Smoking has a ______ effect on the lungs over time.
sentences.zh: 吸菸長期下來對肺部會產生有害的影響。

sentences.en: The ______ rumor spread quickly and damaged her reputation.
sentences.zh: 這則有害的謠言迅速傳開,損害了她的名譽。

sentences.en: He gave a ______ apology that didn't seem sincere at all.
sentences.zh: 他做出了一個敷衍的道歉,聽起來一點也不真誠。

sentences.en: The security guard did only a ______ check of everyone's bags.
sentences.zh: 警衛只對每個人的包包做了敷衍了事的檢查。

sentences.en: He took a ______ pleasure in making his classmates uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 他從讓同學感到不自在中得到一種乖戾的快感。

sentences.en: It seems ______ to spend more money just to save time on such a small task.
sentences.zh: 為了在這種小事上省時間而花更多錢,似乎是種不合理的固執。

sentences.en: Please provide only the ______ information needed for the application.
sentences.zh: 請只提供申請所需的相關資訊。

sentences.en: The lawyer asked several ______ questions during the trial.
sentences.zh: 律師在審判過程中提出了幾個相關的問題。

sentences.en: She took an hour to ______ the contract before signing it.
sentences.zh: 她花了一小時仔細閱讀合約後才簽字。

sentences.en: He liked to ______ the newspaper over breakfast every morning.
sentences.zh: 他喜歡每天早上邊吃早餐邊仔細閱讀報紙。

sentences.en: The smell of fresh bread began to ______ every corner of the house.
sentences.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香氣開始彌漫整棟房子的每個角落。

sentences.en: A sense of optimism seemed to ______ the entire office after the good news.
sentences.zh: 好消息傳來後,一股樂觀的氣氛似乎彌漫了整個辦公室。

sentences.en: Despite countless setbacks, she chose to ______ and finish the marathon.
sentences.zh: 儘管遭遇無數挫折,她仍選擇堅持不懈,完成了馬拉松。

sentences.en: He encouraged his students to ______ even when the material seemed impossible.
sentences.zh: 即使教材看似困難重重,他仍鼓勵學生堅持下去。

sentences.en: The gang was believed to have ______ several robberies in the area.
sentences.zh: 這個幫派被認為在該地區犯下了多起搶劫案。

sentences.en: No one could explain why he would ______ such a cruel act.
sentences.zh: 沒有人能解釋他為何會做出如此殘忍的行為。

sentences.en: His book describes his years-long ______ across five continents.
sentences.zh: 他的書描述了他歷時多年、走遍五大洲的旅程。

sentences.en: The old sailor loved to recount tales from his many ______ around the world.
sentences.zh: 這位老水手喜歡講述他環遊世界多次旅程的故事。

sentences.en: The myth continued to ______ itself through generations of retelling.
sentences.zh: 這個迷思透過一代又一代的口耳相傳而持續流傳。

sentences.en: Critics argued the policy would only ______ inequality.
sentences.zh: 批評者主張這項政策只會使不平等現象持續下去。

sentences.en: The ______ detective noticed the tiny detail everyone else had missed.
sentences.zh: 這位洞察力敏銳的偵探注意到了其他人都忽略的細微線索。

sentences.en: Her ______ analysis of the market predicted the crash months early.
sentences.zh: 她對市場敏銳的分析提前好幾個月就預測到了這場崩盤。

sentences.en: Safety is of ______ importance during the construction project.
sentences.zh: 在這項建築工程中,安全是最重要的考量。

sentences.en: The judge ruled that the child's welfare was ______.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定孩子的福祉是至高無上的考量。

sentences.en: The manager's ______ tone left no room for discussion.
sentences.zh: 經理專橫的語氣讓人毫無討論的餘地。

sentences.en: She gave a ______ order for everyone to leave the building at once.
sentences.zh: 她下達了一道不容反抗的命令,要求所有人立刻離開這棟大樓。

sentences.en: The ______ advisor secretly worked for the enemy kingdom.
sentences.zh: 這位背信棄義的謀士暗中為敵國效力。

sentences.en: History remembers him as a ______ traitor who betrayed his closest allies.
sentences.zh: 歷史記得他是個背叛了最親密盟友的奸詐叛徒。

sentences.en: Even during the crisis, the CEO remained ______.
sentences.zh: 即使在這場危機當中,執行長依然保持鎮定自若。

sentences.en: Her ______ calm reassured the nervous passengers during the turbulence.
sentences.zh: 在遭遇亂流時,她那種泰然自若的鎮定安撫了緊張的乘客。

words.defn_en: not affected or influenced by something:

sentences.en: The material is ______ to water, making it ideal for roofing.
sentences.zh: 這種材料不透水,非常適合用於屋頂建材。

sentences.en: He seemed completely ______ to criticism, no matter how harsh.
sentences.zh: 無論批評有多嚴厲,他似乎都完全不受影響。

sentences.en: Her ______ writing style made the dense subject accessible to beginners.
sentences.zh: 她清晰易懂的寫作風格讓這個艱澀的主題也能讓初學者理解。

sentences.en: The mountain lake was so ______ that fish could be seen swimming far below.
sentences.zh: 這座高山湖泊清澈見底,連遠處游動的魚都看得一清二楚。

words.defn_en: to walk about or through a place, especially for pleasure:

sentences.en: They enjoyed the chance to ______ through the old city streets.
sentences.zh: 他們喜歡有機會漫步穿越這座老城的街道。

sentences.en: He would ______ the garden every evening before dinner.
sentences.zh: 他每天晚餐前都會在花園裡漫步。

words.defn_en: lasting for a long or seemingly infinite time; recurring:

sentences.en: Traffic remains a ______ problem in the growing city.
sentences.zh: 交通問題在這座日益發展的城市中始終是個長期難題。

sentences.en: She planted several ______ flowers that bloom every spring.
sentences.zh: 她種了好幾株每年春天都會開花的多年生植物。

words.root_note: per- (thoroughly) + fervidus (glowing, ardent), from Latin fervere (to boil)

sentences.en: His ______ speech energized the crowd of supporters.
sentences.zh: 他狂熱的演講讓這群支持者的情緒沸騰起來。

sentences.en: The novel's ______ romance felt exaggerated to some readers.
sentences.zh: 這本小說熾熱狂放的愛情故事讓一些讀者覺得有些誇張。

words.root_note: per- (through, thoroughly) + fides (faith), from Latin, implying breach of faith

sentences.en: The betrayal exposed the depths of his ______ .
sentences.zh: 這次背叛揭露了他背信棄義的深沉程度。

sentences.en: History remembers the general for his cunning and ______ .
sentences.zh: 歷史記住了這位將軍的狡詐與奸詐背信。

words.defn_en: deliberate breach of faith or trust; treachery:

sentences.en: The spy's ______ endangered the lives of his entire unit.
sentences.zh: 這位間諜的背信行為危及了整個部隊的性命。

sentences.en: The novel explores themes of loyalty and ______ during wartime.
sentences.zh: 這本小說探討了戰時的忠誠與背信這兩個主題。

words.root_note: per- (thoroughly) + fumare (to smoke), from Latin, via French parfumer

sentences.en: The ______ letter arrived carrying a faint scent of roses.
sentences.zh: 這封灑了香水的信寄來時帶著淡淡的玫瑰香氣。

sentences.en: Her ______ handkerchief left a lingering fragrance in the room.
sentences.zh: 她那灑了香水的手帕在房間裡留下了縈繞不去的香氣。

sentences.en: The marker left a ______ stain on my favorite shirt that I won't be able to get out.
sentences.zh: 這支馬克筆在我最喜歡的襯衫上留下了永久的污漬,怎麼洗都洗不掉。

sentences.en: He decided to make the move to the countryside ______.
sentences.zh: 他決定永久搬到鄉下居住。

sentences.en: The con artist lived in ______ fear of being arrested.
sentences.zh: 這名騙子一直活在隨時可能被逮捕的持續恐懼之中。

sentences.en: The city seems to be in a state of ______ construction.
sentences.zh: 這座城市似乎永遠處於不斷施工的狀態。

sentences.en: The riddle continued to ______ even the brightest students.
sentences.zh: 這道謎題持續困擾著即使是最聰明的學生。

sentences.en: Her sudden change in behavior began to ______ her closest friends.
sentences.zh: 她行為的突然轉變開始讓她最親近的朋友感到困惑。

sentences.en: The regime continued to ______ anyone who spoke out against it.
sentences.zh: 這個政權持續迫害任何公開反對它的人。

sentences.en: Throughout history, minority groups have often been ______d for their beliefs.
sentences.zh: 縱觀歷史,少數族群經常因其信仰而遭受迫害。

sentences.en: The dinner conversation was full of witty ______ rather than serious discussion.
sentences.zh: 這場晚餐的對話充滿了機智的調侃,而非嚴肅的討論。

sentences.en: Their playful ______ masked a genuine affection between the old friends.
sentences.zh: 他們之間輕鬆的戲謔調侃,掩藏著這對老朋友之間真摯的情誼。

words.defn_en: continuing firmly or steadily in a course of action despite difficulties or opposition:

sentences.en: His ______ efforts to improve the system eventually paid off.
sentences.zh: 他堅持不懈地努力改善這套系統,最終有了回報。

sentences.en: After fifty years of buying lottery tickets, ______ efforts paid off when he won the jackpot.
sentences.zh: 在買了五十年彩券之後,他堅持不懈的努力終於得到回報,中了頭獎。

sentences.en: Her ______ allowed her to spot the flaw in the plan immediately.
sentences.zh: 她的敏銳洞察力讓她立刻發現了這項計畫的漏洞。

sentences.en: The detective's ______ helped him solve the case within days.
sentences.zh: 這位偵探的敏銳洞察力幫助他在數天內就破了案。

sentences.en: The report was praised for its ______ despite covering complex data.
sentences.zh: 這份報告儘管涵蓋了複雜的數據,仍因其清楚易懂而備受讚譽。

sentences.en: Good technical writing depends on ______ rather than jargon.
sentences.zh: 好的技術寫作依賴的是清晰明瞭,而非專業術語。

sentences.en: The ______ reporter refused to stop asking questions until she got a real answer.
sentences.zh: 這位固執的記者不肯罷休,直到得到一個真正的答案為止。

sentences.en: His ______ pursuit of the patent eventually paid off after years of rejection.
sentences.zh: 他頑強地追求這項專利,在多年遭拒後終於獲得了回報。

sentences.en: A careful ______ of the contract revealed a hidden fee.
sentences.zh: 仔細審閱這份合約後,發現了一項隱藏的費用。

sentences.en: The manuscript deserves closer ______ before publication.
sentences.zh: 這份手稿在出版前值得更仔細地審閱。

words.defn_en: spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people:

sentences.en: The ______ scent of freshly baked cookies filled the entire house.
sentences.zh: 剛烤好的餅乾香氣瀰漫了整棟房子。

sentences.en: Corruption remains a ______ problem in many governments.
sentences.zh: 貪腐依然是許多政府中普遍存在的問題。

words.defn_en: an unintended consequence or effect, often negative:

sentences.en: The ______ of her decision was felt by everyone in the organization.
sentences.zh: 她這項決定所帶來的後果讓整個組織的每個人都感受到了。

sentences.en: Losing the contract had serious financial ______ for the company.
sentences.zh: 失去這份合約為公司帶來了嚴重的財務後果。
